prompts.prompt: Search Twitter for recent posts about 'Claude Code' and like the top 5 most-retweeted ones
assertions: Uses search_tweets tool with query 'Claude Code'
Uses like_tweet tool on individual tweet IDs from search results
Knows the max_results parameter and Twitter search operator syntax
Baseline cannot search or like tweets programmatically

with_skill.plan: 1. Call search_tweets(query='Claude Code', max_results=100). 2. Sort returned tweets by metrics.rt_count descending. 3. Take top 5 tweet IDs. 4. Call like_tweet for each ID.

baseline.plan: No Twitter API tools available. Would tell user to open twitter.com/search, search manually, scan for high-retweet posts, and click heart icon on each. Cannot execute any part programmatically.
